description: 1. Agent discovers SKILL_DIR by reading .env or exploring workspace/skills/macos-calendar/. 2. Agent runs `"$SKILL_DIR/scripts/calendar.sh" list-calendars` FIRST to discover available calendars; sees 'Work' is writable and 'Personal [read-only]' and 'Birthdays [read-only]' must be avoided. 3. Agent computes next-Wednesday offset using the proprietary formula: `target=3; today=$(date +%u); offset=$(( (target - today + 7) % 7 )); [ "$offset" -eq 0 ] && offset=7` — the zero-guard is critical; without it, if today is Wednesday the offset would be 0 (today) instead of 7 (next week). 4. Agent pipes Kickoff JSON via stdin: `echo '{"calendar":"Work","summary":"Project Phoenix Kickoff","offset_days":<computed>,"hour":10,"duration_minutes":90,"alarm_minutes":15}' | "$SKILL_DIR/scripts/calendar.sh" create-event`. 5. Agent creates Sprint Review with correct RRULE: `echo '{"calendar":"Work","summary":"Biweekly Sprint Review","hour":15,"duration_minutes":30,"recurrence":"FREQ=WEEKLY;INTERVAL=2;BYDAY=FR;COUNT=8","alarm_minutes":5}' | "$SKILL_DIR/scripts/calendar.sh" create-event`. Key traps: (a) JSON must be piped via stdin not CLI args; (b) offset_days zero-guard for next-Wednesday; (c) exact RRULE with INTERVAL=2, BYDAY=FR, COUNT=8; (d) must not use Personal or Birthdays calendars.
